svg.aria-label: Control Plane sits above many Kubernetes clusters. Clusters reach it three ways: built-in Control Plane regions on AWS, GCP, Azure, and OCI; Managed Kubernetes clusters Control Plane provisions on your infrastructure; and CPLN BYOK clusters you already run. Each becomes a location a GVC can span.
svg.text: Orchestrates many hardened, isolated Kubernetes clusters and gives every workload the same platform
A cluster you already run, joined
as a location of your own
Each of these is a location a GVC can span
